items.stem: Under the shared responsibility model, which task belongs to AWS for Amazon EC2?

options.rationale: On EC2 (IaaS) the customer patches the guest OS.
Security group rules are set by the customer.

options.text: Securing the physical hosts and the virtualisation layer
options.rationale: Correct: AWS is responsible for security OF the cloud: hardware, facilities and the hypervisor.
The customer chooses and manages data encryption.

items.explanation: Correct: AWS is responsible for security OF the cloud: hardware, facilities and the hypervisor.

items.stem: Which pricing model gives the biggest discount for steady, predictable usage in return for a 1- or 3-year commitment?

options.rationale: On-Demand has no commitment and no discount.
Correct: commitment-based models trade a term commitment for lower rates.
Spot gives deep discounts but can be interrupted, so it does not suit steady predictable load.
Dedicated Hosts cost more and are used for licensing or compliance reasons.

items.explanation: Correct: commitment-based models trade a term commitment for lower rates.

items.stem: Which AWS service records API calls made in an account, for auditing?

options.rationale: CloudWatch handles metrics, logs and alarms. API audit trails come from CloudTrail.
Correct: CloudTrail records API activity for governance and audit.
Config records resource configuration state, not API calls.

items.explanation: Correct: CloudTrail records API activity for governance and audit.
